name: play2
description: Play2 - Plataforma cristiana de musica: alabanzas, adoraciones, predicas y mas. Busca en YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Vimeo y Apple Music previews.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
